purpose: greybox SFX starter pack so the 18 Oct mechanics gate can judge feel with audio; style-neutral, replaced or remixed after the style pick
common: Clean, close-miked game sound effect, no music, no voice, no speech, no words, no reverb tail longer than needed, no background noise.

cues.text: A soft shimmering trail of flowing water and faint glassy sparkle, continuous and even, as a fingertip draws a glowing line in the air.
A bright, clean magical chime with a splash of water, a spell sigil snapping into place, satisfying and short.
A dull short fizzle, water spell fizzling out like a drop on hot stone, clearly a failure but not harsh.
A quick small water projectile launched from a hand, tight whoosh with a wet snap.
A heavy orb of water launched forward, deep rushing swell and a rolling whoosh.
A curved shield of water forming in front of a raised palm, fast rising rush of water locking into a hum.
A low steady rippling hum of a water barrier being held, gentle and continuous, seamless loop.
A projectile hitting a water shield and being absorbed, muffled splash with a soft thud.
A perfect magical block: a crystalline ring and a rising shimmering chime over a water splash, rewarding and bright.
A magical blow striking a person, short heavy thud with a hiss, no voice.
A quick airy displacement, a soft pop and a short swoosh of someone teleporting a few steps.
A fireball flying toward the listener, crackling roaring whoosh that grows louder.
A fireball exploding on sand, a short burst of flame and scattering embers.
An ominous deep rising tone with a dark rumble, warning that something unstoppable is coming.
A bronze rune clicking into place with a warm metallic ring and a soft glow swell.
A single soft ascending water note, a small pleasant pluck.
A great wave cresting and crashing, powerful rising rush of water ending in a bright magical burst.
A creature made of embers snarling, a crackling fiery growl, no human voice.
Distant murmur of a large crowd in an open stone arena, steady and seamless, no individual words.
A soft muted low tone for pausing, gentle and quiet.
A short sharp sword swing through the air, a fast metal whoosh of a soldier attacking.
A blunt sword blow striking a wooden shield, a hard knock with a brief metallic rattle.
A soldier in armour collapsing, a clatter of metal plates and a dull thud on sand, no human voice.
A leather sling whirling a stone in fast circles, a rising rhythmic whirr ending in a sharp snap of release.
A hurled stone striking packed sand and stone, a hard crack and a short scatter of grit.
A small stone hitting a leather cuirass, a short sharp smack and thud.
A light soldier falling to the sand, a soft clatter of leather gear and a muffled thump, no human voice.
A fiery beast drawing breath to spit, a low rising crackle and hiss as glowing embers gather, slow and ominous.
A slow glowing ember spat through the air, a soft fiery spit with a lazy crackling whoosh.
A creature of embers dying, a crackling hiss collapsing into scattered sparks and a last soft burst, no human voice.
A huge creature rising out of thick bog mud, a heavy wet squelch and bubbling suck of mire.
A heavy wet creature lunging forward, a fast slap of mud and a gulping snap.
A giant bog creature sinking and collapsing into mud, a long wet gurgle and slump, no human voice.
A heavy wooden portcullis gate being raised in a stone arena, deep chain rattle, creaking timber and a final stone thud.
A large crowd cheering in an open stone arena, a swelling roar of applause and excitement, no individual words.
